title: In the Driver's Seat: A Multi-Company Study on the Reality of Autonomous Driving System Testing
abstract: arXiv:2607.15820v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autonomous driving systems (ADS) are increasingly deployed in complex real-world environments, creating strong demands for rigorous testing to establish their functionality and safety. However, ADS testing remains difficult because practitioners must determine not only what and how to test, but also whether the resulting evidence is sufficient to support progression and release decisions. To understand how this is handled in practice, we conducted semi-structured interviews with experts involved in ADS development and testing across nine companies in six countries. Through thematic analysis, we examined how practitioners organize ADS testing to produce and assess evidence, and what limits confidence in that evidence. translated_title: 掌控方向盘：自动驾驶系统测试现实的多公司研究
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）日益被部署于复杂的现实环境中，这对建立其功能性和安全性所需的严格测试提出了强烈需求。然而，自动驾驶系统测试仍然困难重重，因为从业者不仅需要确定测试什么以及如何测试，还必须判断由此产生的证据是否足以支持推进和发布决策。为了解实践中如何应对这些问题，我们对来自六个国家九家公司的自动驾驶系统开发与测试专家进行了半结构化访谈。通过主题分析，我们考察了从业者如何组织自动驾驶系统测试以产生和评估证据，以及哪些因素限制了对这些证据的信心。我们的研究结果表明，工业界的自动驾驶系统测试可以理解为一个证据构建过程，其中涉及三种反复出现的活动：规划所需证据、跨互补渠道产生和评估证据……
tldr: 该研究通过对六个国家九家公司专家的访谈，首次系统揭示了工业界自动驾驶系统测试的真实运作方式——一个由规划证据需求、产生与评估证据等反复活动构成的证据构建过程。
en_tdlr: This multi-company interview study across nine companies in six countries reveals that industrial autonomous driving system testing operates in practice as an evidence-building process involving recurring activities of planning evidence needs and producing and evaluating evidence.
